svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: SMC Marks - animated trade walkthrough

g.text: Example: structure is bearish (LH, LL) and a CHoCH is awaited.
A CHoCH breaks the last LH: bias flips bullish, Discount is marked.
Illustrated BUY: entry in Discount, SL below the HL, TP at 3R.
TP is hit in this example (+3R). A new HH and a BMS follow.
A bearish CHoCH flips bias and price pulls back into Premium.
Illustrated SELL: entry in Premium, SL above the LH, TP at 2.5R.
TP is hit in this example (+2.5R). Animation only, not advice.
An illustration of how a trade could play out.
Prices are made up. This is NOT financial advice
and NOT a trading lesson or a promise of results.
